'use client' import { Trophy, Target, Zap, TrendingUp } from 'lucide-react' import { PASSING_GRADES, SUBJECTS } from '@/lib/constants' interface Stat { label: string value: string | number subValue?: string icon: React.ElementType color: string // Tailwind text class bg: string // Tailwind bg class borderColor: string } export default function StatOverview({ data, streak, type }: { data: any, streak: number, type?: string }) { const totalFullMark = SUBJECTS.TWK.fullMark + SUBJECTS.TIU.fullMark + SUBJECTS.TKP.fullMark let avgScoreSub = `Dari Total ${totalFullMark}` const avgLabel = "Rata-rata Skor" // Determine Passing Grade based on Type if (type) { if (type === 'twk') avgScoreSub = `/ ${PASSING_GRADES.TWK} (Passing Grade)` else if (type === 'tiu') avgScoreSub = `/ ${PASSING_GRADES.TIU} (Passing Grade)` else if (type === 'tkp') avgScoreSub = `/ ${PASSING_GRADES.TKP} (Passing Grade)` else if (type === 'tryout') avgScoreSub = `/ ${totalFullMark} (SKD)` } const stats: Stat[] = [ { label: "Total Latihan", value: data.summary.totalSessions, subValue: "Sesi Selesai", icon: Target, color: "text-blue-700", bg: "bg-blue-200", borderColor: "border-blue-400" }, { label: avgLabel, value: data.summary.avgScore, subValue: avgScoreSub, icon: TrendingUp, color: "text-purple-700", bg: "bg-purple-200", borderColor: "border-purple-400" }, { label: "Skor Tertinggi", value: data.summary.maxScore, subValue: "Personal Best", icon: Trophy, color: "text-yellow-700", bg: "bg-yellow-200", borderColor: "border-yellow-400" }, { label: "Current Streak", value: `${streak} Hari`, subValue: "Konsistensi", icon: Zap, color: "text-orange-700", bg: "bg-orange-200", borderColor: "border-orange-400" } ] return (
{stats.map((stat, idx) => (

{stat.value}

{stat.label}

{stat.subValue &&

{stat.subValue}

}
))}
) }
